function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Reconstruct the complete public evidence chain for the 2023 3CX DesktopApp software supply-chain compromise, using authoritative and primary public sources where available. Cover: (1) how the compromise was initiated, including the initial access vector, malicious or trojanized components, and a dated chronology; (2) how it propagated into or affected 3CX developer systems, build infrastructure, source code, signing, packaging, and distribution, carefully distinguishing directly evidenced relationships from hypotheses; (3) how compromised DesktopApp versions reached users, including update mechanisms, supported platforms and versions if documented, observable files, hashes, domains, network behavior, payload stages, and other artifacts; and (4) public attribution to a threat-activity cluster, explicitly separating confirmed facts, victim/vendor statements, law-enforcement or government statements, private-sector analytic assessments, competing attributions, allegations, and unresolved uncertainty. Return a readable evidence synthesis with a unique source ID for every source and precise citations/source IDs attached to each factual claim. Do not invent facts, entity IDs, or relationship names; only use identifiers actually present in the sources or clearly label ordinary names as unmodeled. Include chronology and note disagreements or gaps. The eventual report must cite only the source IDs you return."}
function.name: ConductResearch
